title: CapabilityDescriptor
description: Capability metadata returned by Fabric.discover_capabilities(). Planner uses this to build PlanStep fields.

provider_type.description: Type of provider (matches Fabric's 6+1 provider taxonomy from fabric_new.mmd). Determines whether prompt_template is needed and affects timeout estimation.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema for capability input parameters. Planner validates params against this.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema for capability output. Forwarded to PlanStep.output_schema for OutputSchemaGuard.

safety_band_min.description: Minimum safety band required. Planner checks against PlanRequest.constraints.safety_band.

has_side_effects.description: If true, Planner sets PlanStep.has_side_effects=True for saga compensation.

compensation_capability.description: Capability to call for rollback. Forwarded to PlanStep.compensation.

estimated_duration_ms.description: Estimated execution time. Planner uses this for timeout_ms and BUDGET-1 time estimation.

domains.description: Semantic domains this capability belongs to.

description.description: Human-readable description for Planner LLM context.
